research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build

value.statement: If the function-field extension of f is Galois the monodromy action is regular and |G| = d, and by Campbell's criterion f is then invertible; so a nontrivial Keller groupoid has |G| > d. There is no degree-two complex Keller counterexample, and S_3 in degree three is the first non-Galois possibility.
